title: AnolisVLA: Lightweight Vision-Language-Action Model with Deep State Space Models for Mobile Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2603.15046v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this study, we address the problem of language-guided robotic manipulation, where a robot is required to manipulate a wide range of objects based on visual observations and natural language instructions. This task is essential for service robots that operate in human environments, and requires safety, efficiency, and task-level generality. Although Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have demonstrated strong performance for this task, their deployment in resource-constrained environments remains challenging because of the computational cost of standard transformer backbones. To overcome this limitation, we propose AnolisVLA, a lightweight VLA that uses a deep state space model to process multimodal sequences efficiently. The model uses lightweight, fast sequential state modeling to process visual and textual inputs. This design enables efficient trajectory generation. translated_title: AnolisVLA：基于深度状态空间模型的面向移动操作的轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: 在本研究中，我们解决了语言引导的机器人操作问题，即机器人需要根据视觉观察和自然语言指令来操作各种物体。这一任务对于在人类环境中工作的服务机器人至关重要，需要具备安全性、高效性和任务级通用性。尽管视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在此任务上已展现出强大的性能，但由于标准Transformer骨干网络的计算成本较高，其在资源受限环境中的部署仍然具有挑战性。为了克服这一限制，我们提出了AnolisVLA，一种利用深度状态空间模型高效处理多模态序列的轻量级VLA。该模型采用轻量、快速的序列状态建模方法来处理视觉和文本输入，这一设计能够实现高效的轨迹生成。我们在仿真环境中以及两个……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了AnolisVLA，一种用深度状态空间模型替代Transformer骨干的轻量级视觉-语言-动作模型，能够高效处理多模态输入并生成轨迹，从而实现资源受限环境下的语言引导移动操作。
en_tdlr: AnolisVLA is a lightweight Vision-Language-Action model that replaces costly transformer backbones with a deep state space model, enabling efficient multimodal sequence processing and trajectory generation for language-guided mobile manipulation in resource-constrained environments.
